subject: Your parcel could not be delivered
top_finding: Sender domain imitates a known domain

message.subject: Your parcel could not be delivered
message.excerpt:
We attempted to deliver your parcel but nobody was home. Reschedule delivery within 24 hours or the parcel will be returned.

http://203.0.113.45/dhl/reschedule

urls.text: Track your DHL parcel at dhl.com

findings.title: Sender domain imitates a known domain
evidence: Sender domain dhl-parcel-notice[.]example wraps the name from dhl[.]com in extra words (imitating DHL)
findings.lesson: Read the domain letter by letter. Attackers register names that look right at a glance.

findings.title: Link text shows one site, link goes to another
evidence: Link reads "Track your DHL parcel at dhl[.]com" but goes to 203[.]0[.]113[.]45
findings.lesson: What a link says and where it goes can differ. Hover to see the real destination before clicking.

findings.title: Link goes to a raw IP address
findings.lesson: Real companies use names, not numbers. A link to an IP address is almost never legitimate.

indicators.reason: link goes to a raw IP address

note.summary: Rated malicious with a combined score of 0.95. Strongest signal: sender domain imitates a known domain.
